test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jun, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks.

We have four seasons because the earth doesn’t sit up straight; it’s _______ on its axis. As it orbits the sun, the planet’s slight slouch _______ more or less of the northern and southern hemisphere to the sun depending on the time of the year.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"sloped"** means to have an inclined or slanted direction or angle. (ढलान वाला)

 
 
• **Example: **The roof is **sloped** to allow rainwater to run off.
 
 
 
• **"tilted" **refers to being inclined or slanted from a vertical position. (झुका हुआ)
 
 
• **Example: **The picture was **tilted** slightly to the left.
 
 
 
• Hence, the earth is tilted on its axis, exposing more or less of the hemispheres to the sun.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Sloped **(ढलान वाला): Having an inclined or slanted direction or angle.

 
 
• **Example:** The road sloped down to the river.
 
 
 
• **Slanted **(तिरछा): Positioned or directed in a sloping or oblique direction.
 
 
• **Example: **The sunlight slanted through the trees.
 
 
 
• **Inclined **(झुका हुआ): Deviating in direction from the horizontal or vertical; sloping.
 
 
• **Example:** The inclined plane made it easier to move heavy objects.
